The Buffalo River country

Jasper is the county seat of Newton County, a small town in the middle of some of the best hiking, floating and scenery in Arkansas. Branson and Eureka Springs are each about an hour away.

  • Buffalo National RiverAmerica's first national river. Float, swim and fish from accesses like Pruitt, Ozark and Kyle's Landing.
  • Arkansas Grand CanyonThe overlook on Highway 7 south of Jasper, with miles of Ozark ridges below. Best near sunset.
  • Lost Valley TrailAn easy hike near Ponca to Eden Falls and a cave you can walk into.
  • Elk in Boxley ValleyWild elk graze the fields near Ponca, most often at dawn and dusk.
  • Hawksbill CragA rock ledge over the upper Buffalo valley and one of the most photographed spots in Arkansas.
  • Downtown JasperOzark Cafe, Pizza on the Square, and the Cliff House Inn restaurant on the canyon rim.
  • Mystic CavernsGuided cave tours on Highway 7 north toward Harrison.
  • Branson and Eureka SpringsEach about an hour away for shows, shops and a day trip.

Questions people ask

Where are your cabins?

Both properties are on Scenic Byway 7 (Highway 7) in Jasper, Arkansas. Little Switzerland is 2.5 miles north of town and Morwood House is 1 mile south, about 3.5 miles apart.

Which is best for a couple?

Cabin 2 at Little Switzerland, renovated in December 2025 with a king bed and private balcony, from $110 a night. Rooms 3 and 4 are queen suites from $85. For a splurge, Morwood House gives you a whole house and a hot tub.

Which is best for a family or a group?

Morwood House sleeps 8 with three bedrooms, two baths, a full kitchen, hot tub and game room. At Little Switzerland, Cabin 1 and Room 5 each sleep 4.

What's the largest group you can host?

22 overnight guests if you book Morwood House (8) and all five Little Switzerland units (14) together.

Are you pet friendly?

Dogs are welcome at Little Switzerland for $25 per pet per stay. For Morwood House, ask before you book.

How close are you to the Buffalo National River?

A few minutes. Both properties are on Highway 7, which crosses the Buffalo at Pruitt just north of Little Switzerland.

Do the cabins have kitchens?

Morwood House has a full kitchen. The Little Switzerland units have a mini fridge, microwave and coffee maker, plus shared grills under a covered pavilion.

Why book direct?

Same places and the same calendar as Airbnb and VRBO, without the app's service fee, and you deal with the owner.
